machine.description: AIBOM provenance pin on a domain admission or an epoch swap: the AIBOM assembler collects every digest, and the verdict follows its completion and the verifier: permit only when nothing is unpinned and the verifier agrees.

inputSemantics: req_domain_admit (binary; fact: scripts/approve-domain.sh prepare (admission request); partial): a domain admission is requested
req_epoch_swap (binary; fact: scripts/approve-domain.sh deploy / domains/deployments (epoch request); partial): a rule-epoch swap is requested
reserved: lane_in_workflow (lifecycle frame lane 2; the asset is in its workflow)
reserved: lane_re_pinned (lifecycle frame lane 3; a frame document has been re-pinned (T16))
reserved: lane_approved (lifecycle frame lane 4; approved by a distinct human principal)
reserved: lane_rework (lifecycle frame lane 5; rework requested)
reserved: lane_step_running (lifecycle frame lane 6; a step is running)
reserved: lane_stale (lifecycle frame lane 7; the head is STALE (continuation TTL or lease expired))
aibom_assembled (binary; aigov-aibom-assembler completion via aigov.gov05.aibom-assembler.completion): the AIBOM is assembled
aibom_failed (binary; aigov-aibom-assembler completion via aigov.gov05.aibom-assembler.completion): the agent's step failed
unpinned_items (binary; aigov-aibom-assembler completion via aigov.gov05.aibom-assembler.completion): the assembler found items it could not pin
gate_aibom_pinned (binary; fact: AIBOM verifier over the frame's AIBOM document; new): every model, quantization, tap and dictionary digest is pinned

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)

rules.description: M-GOV-05 S0_Idle → S1_AgentRunning: ([req_domain_admit=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ aibom_assembled=0] | [req_epoch_swap=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ aibom_assembled=0])

M-GOV-05 S1_AgentRunning → S2_Pinned: ([req_domain_admit=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ aibom_assembled=0] | [req_epoch_swap=1 ∧ lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ aibom_assembled=0]) · [aibom_assembled=1 ∧ unpinned_items=0 ∧ gate_aibom_pinned=1]
M-GOV-05 S1_AgentRunning → S_fail_UnpinnedModel: [lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ aibom_assembled=0] · [aibom_assembled=1 ∧ unpinned_items=1]
M-GOV-05 S1_AgentRunning → S_fail_UnpinnedModel: [lane_in_workflow=1 ∧ lane_step_running=1 ∧ aibom_assembled=0] · [aibom_assembled=1 ∧ unpinned_items=0 ∧ gate_aibom_pinned=0]

interconnections.purpose: Hand the frame's AIBOMManifest to GOV04, its next consumer (agentic-workflow-contract.json W1,W2); never infer a governance verdict from document content.

conversion.transitionRule: SURFACE_SPEC.md, Boundaries: where a K-line starts and ends
conversion.elementEncoding: binary: equals; interval [lo,hi]: threshold, value (lo+hi)/2, threshold (hi-lo)/2; unconstrained: threshold 0.5 +/- 0.5

allowedActions: Write the AIBOM document into the frame.

frameInputs.lanes: input cells 2-7, written by the lifecycle (reserved)
frameInputs.facts: every other non-completion input, written into the clone's block by the lifecycle's frame source (GOV-R19)
frameInputs.completion: input cells 8..10, the step agent's completion
